will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wills.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willy.definition: Any of various deciduous trees or shrubs in the genus Salix, in the willow family Salicaceae, found primarily on moist soils in cooler zones in the northern hemisphere.

willy-nilly.definition: Whether desired or not; without regard for consequences or wishes of those affected; whether willingly or unwillingly.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wing.definition: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

winter.definition: Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as spanning either the period between the winter solstice to the spring equinox, or the months of December, January, and February in temperate and polar regions of the Northern Hemisphere and the months of June, July, and August in the Southern Hemisphere. It is the time when the sun is lowest in the sky, resulting in short days, and the time of year with the lowest atmospheric temperatures for the region.

wires.definition: Metal formed into a thin, even thread, now usually by being drawn through a hole in a steel die.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wiser.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wisest.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wish.definition: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.

wished.definition: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.

wishes.definition: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.

with.definition: A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdrawal.definition: Receiving from someone's care what one has earlier entrusted to them. Usually refers to money.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

woe.definition: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

womb.definition: In female mammals, the organ in which the young are conceived and grow until birth; the uterus.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wonders.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

word.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

words.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

workers.definition: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worms.definition: A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worse.definition: To issue a command; to tell.

worship.definition: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.

worth.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

worthiness.definition: The state or quality of having value or merit.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wound.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

woven.definition: To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writers.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrongdoing.definition: To do something wrong; to break a rule or offend.

wrongly.definition: In violation of a moral or other standard, code, or convention; in an unfair, unjust, dishonest, or immoral manner; wrongly convicted is synonymous with wrongful conviction and miscarriage of justice.

wrote.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

year.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
